title: resourcehub.net sources entry
description: An official data feed, API, dataset, model, standard or reference, with how to access it and when its link was last checked. A listing, not an endorsement or a ranking.

url.description: The provider's own page for the source.

subject.description: What the source is about; the page filters on it.

provides.description: What it provides, in our own words.

access.description: free: no account; free-with-key: a free registration or key; key-or-paid: a key, with paid tiers or contract terms; paid; membership; restricted: not open to the public.

license.description: The licence of the model, dataset or reference repository, as stated on its card or repository.

stars.description: GitHub stars of the reference repository on counted_on: a snapshot, not a quality score.

likes.description: Hugging Face likes on counted_on: a snapshot, not a quality score.

counted_on.description: Date stars or likes were counted.

last_checked.description: US Eastern date the link was opened and the entry checked against the page.

link_check.description: ok: the page opened and was read. bot-blocked or timeout: kept only when otherwise known-good; link_note says why.

claim.description: verified: the description was checked against the page on last_checked; unverified otherwise.
